newsitem.title: USA: Med/Waste says expects Q2 ahead of 1996 Q2.
newsitem.headline: Med/Waste says expects Q2 ahead of 1996 Q2.

text.p: Med/Waste Inc said Tuesday it expects its second quarter to be " well ahead" of the comparable 1996 period, and it is actively seeking acquisition candidates.

The company reported net income for the first quarter of $150,037, or $0.06 per share, compared to $87,266, or $0.05 per share, for the same period a year ago. The company said the earnings per share results were acheived based on 22 percent more shares outstanding in fiscal 1997.

The company said it expects to have cross-marketing and expansion opportunities for its services in the remainder of the fiscal year with the Biomedical Waste Systems and Bonham Environmental Services deals expected to be completed in the second quarter.
The company announced in March it would buy a 40 percent stake in Biomedical, and announced in April it would buy Bonham, a private company.
The company said Bonham should contribute to its profitability by this year's third quarter.
